_comment: FinOps daily push (design finops-cost-tracking-design-2026-11-16 §4, tracker S2-83 release 2). Read by src/mcp_server/finops_push.py and scripts/build-deploy-finops-push.sh. Project ids come from the environment (USAGE_PROJECT, FINOPS_PROJECT; no defaults). usage_table is the table the cortex-openai-usage log sink writes (Cloud Run stdout, partitioned). The push re-sends the trailing window_days (UTC) on every run, like gmail-digest, so a re-run never double counts and late events are caught.
